name: What R-value is recommended for garage insulation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What R-value is recommended for garage insulation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The recommended R-value for garage insulation in the Bay Area depends on whether the garage is attached or detached, and if it's conditioned (heated/cooled) or unconditioned. For exterior walls separating conditioned space from the garage, general recommendations often align with home exterior wall R-values. For unconditioned attached garages, or detached garages, R-values between R-13 to R-19 for walls and R-25 to R-38 for ceilings are common to provide noticeable comfort and energy benefits, especially for garages used as workshops or living extensions. We can advise on specific R-value needs for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recommended R-values for Bay Area garage insulation vary by attachment and conditioning, with R-13 to R-19 common for walls and R-25 to R-38 for ceilings.
